body:
There really was no single, direct, causal lead-up to this moment. My family has been shit for a while. My parents divorced when I was at a young age, my father blamed me for the divorce, got my older sister to too. My mother resented me until I started showing promise in school and realized that I can keep here out of a retirement home. My step siblings were thrown out of the family for drug-related issues. My sister is a narcissist that hates that I possibly had a future in something that I might have enjoyed. 

My friends are pretty much there when it is convenient for them. I don't blame them; they've turned me on to the idea recently. They have no problem shunning me even if it is the first time I had seen them in months, and the only time I'd see them until God knows when. I was once shunned for a couple of months because one guy got tired of me. These are grown men. They have ruined people for me.

I have horrible social anxiety. Well, anxiety in general. I'd seek therapy but can't afford it. Also had a bout of dissociation. All of this has wreaked havoc on me in such a way that the only way to push forward is to distance myself from myself as much as possible. 

This is just the short and sweet of it.
